messages.author: leon
messages.content: Correction for payment-retry-policy after bank gateway replay: final retryable statuses are 409 lock conflicts, idempotent 425s, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504. Final attempts=5, base_delay_ms=250, max_delay_ms=4000, jitter_ratio=0.20. Because the fifth delay reaches the cap, retry_plan must expose capped=true for retryable statuses so on-call can confirm the cap in dashboards. Do not use the earlier 100ms/8s draft.
